test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All actors are singers.

Some musicians are dancers.

**Conclusion:**

I) All dancers are musicians.

II) Some singers are actors.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.
Both Conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

I. All actors are singers.

II. Some musicians are dancers.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df49e680dad661c015a1f656999f25bb5a05f50bcac418f295d7344d382b333f.png] 

Conclusion:

I) All dancers are musicians. - False (Some musicians are dancers given, but the relation is some. So, it can be possible only).

II) Some singers are actors. -** True** (All actors are singer given, that means some actors occupied some part of singer)

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
